description_expanded: *Must be at least 25 years of age to rent this property. Welcome to The Pyramid House! Located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach on scenic 30A, this architectural gem offers a one-of-a-kind beach getaway with style, space, and serenity. This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home comfortably sleeps 8 guests and features over 2,100 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. With a private heated saltwater pool, a furnished poolside patio, an outdoor shower, a spacious second story deck, Gulf glimpses from the third-floor balcony, and deeded beach access just steps away, The Pyramid House is the ideal escape for families and friends seeking luxury, convenience, and coastal charm. The Pyramid House is made for gathering, both inside and out. The fully equipped kitchen includes everything you need to prepare home-cooked meals, while the adjacent living area features plush furnishings and a large Smart TV for cozy movie nights. Outside, guests can enjoy a show-stopping backyard oasis featuring a private heated saltwater pool (24’ x 17’, 5’ deep; heating fee applies) surrounded by cozy lounge chairs and lush landscaping. The third-floor primary suite offers a private sanctuary, complete with a king bed, Smart TV, and ensuite bathroom featuring a walk-in shower. Located on the second floor, the second bedroom is furnished with a king bed, while the third bedroom offers two double beds—perfect for kids or extra guests. These rooms share easy access to a spacious hallway bathroom with a walk-in shower. Additional amenities include a full-size washer and dryer, high-speed WiFi, and parking for up to three vehicles in the driveway. Located in one of 30A’s most charming and laid-back neighborhoods, The Pyramid House places you just a short walk or bike ride from the sugar-white sand beach, scenic nature trails, local shops, popular restaurants, and the beloved Blue Mountain Creamery. Beyond the neighborhood, you’re perfectly positioned to explore the best of the Emerald Coast—just a short drive from Grand Boulevard’s upscale shopping and dining as well as the lively events and waterfront fun at The Village of Baytowne Wharf. If you're looking to score major deals, Silver Sands Premium Outlets—one of the largest outlet centers in the nation—is less than 15 minutes away. With so much to explore nearby, The Pyramid House gives you effortless access to the best of 30A and beyond. Whether you’re floating in the pool, sipping coffee on the top deck, or catching a sunset stroll on the beach, The Pyramid House offers the perfect blend of comfort, design, and coastal convenience. Book your dream beach vacation, today! **Pool heating is available for an additional $55 per day plus tax and we must schedule this 3 days prior to arrival. Golf Cart Charing Station for Rental Carts - There is not a golf cart included with the property but there is a golf cart charging station, should you wish to rent a golf cart through a local rental company. There are multiple vendors in the area that you are able to utilize. Cancellation: Reservations that are cancelled more than 30 days prior to the arrival date receive a full refund. Reservations cancelled 14-29 days prior to arrival receive a refund of 50% of the amount paid. Reservations cancelled within 14 days of arrival receive no refund unless the guest purchased travel insurance. Guests are required to complete a rental agreement by electronic signature within 3 days of booking. If you wish to have the pool heated it is an additional $65/day (duration of the stay required) and must be scheduled at least 3 days prior to arrival day. NOTE: The total reservation cost includes the nightly rate, clean fee, damage waiver, transportation fee (for select properties), processing fee and tax. By requesting a quote for this property, you agree to be added to our email subscription list.
